correctness.rationale: Finite output fibers are exactly the 2^d possible seeds, with differences indexed by periodic nonzero kernels. Strict and weak likelihood comparisons sandwich Bayes error by binomial-half tails on kernel supports. Periodic densities and the exact binomial tail exponent prove the rate; shifting gives an almost-sure inverse. Window counting proves the lower and upper extremal density bounds, with uniqueness of the lower case. The fair-source posterior is uniform. Exact finite checks in verify.py corroborate the derived finite relations.
